dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: So long as we achieve our goal, what's the harm in trying something new!

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: See, I'm an artisan who's opened a small store here.

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: Everyone says that items created by the Masters of the Night-Wind have special effects, which is why business has been going well.

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: My trick is to first ask customers not what they want, but what they want to do.

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: For example... If someone wants to make a gourmet food detector, I'd suggest that they stay close to the person who they know loves eating the most.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But then, what about your business...

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: Think about it. How would you even make a gourmet food detector, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Xipilli
dialogues.text: Rather than say I can't help them at all, isn't it better to find some other way to help a client solve their problem?
